【原视频简介】
I don't want to spend my life waiting for the weekend.
Or the next holiday.
Or until I have more time, more money, a better studio, or until everything else in life is finally under control.

Because what if we spend so much time waiting for our lives to become more interesting that we forget to actually live the life we already have?

And what if creativity could be part of that?

In this video, I'm talking about making art in the life you actually have — rather than waiting for the perfect time, perfect space or perfect circumstances to finally begin.

From the tiny paintings that grew out of my 365-day Daily Art Challenge, to painting places I can't visit yet, finding little pockets of time to sketch, and learning to notice the ordinary things around me, this is really a conversation about not putting your creative life on hold while you're waiting for your “real” life to begin.

You don't have to give up on your big dreams. You can still take those tiny steps towards them.

But you can also make something today.

You can paint the big picture on a tiny canvas.

You can sketch for ten minutes.

You can find inspiration on an ordinary dog walk.

You can make something at the kitchen table.

You can bring a tiny piece of the life you're dreaming about into the life you're living right now.

And maybe that's where a little bit of everyday magic begins. 🌿✨
